parameters.name: HostAccountIds
parameters.description:
The list of host account IDs.
> This parameter is required. You can call the [ListHostAccounts](~~462937~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: HostShareKeyId
parameters.description:
The ID of the host shared key.
> This parameter is required. You can call the [ListHostShareKeys](~~462973~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the bastion host. You can invoke the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the bastion host. For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).
